_readme: Differences between the development and production Fabric objects that are
CORRECT. Recorded here so the comparison stays quiet about them and says WHY,
rather than either reporting them forever or hiding them silently.
Read automatically by Compare-FabricEnvironment.ps1 from the root of this
folder. The file is optional - without it everything still works, objects
simply pair by filename and nothing is set aside.
pairs               objects whose NAME differs between environments. Without an
entry they cannot pair on filename, and each side reports as
DEV ONLY / PROD ONLY forever.
expectedDifferences differences that are deliberate everywhere. These are SET
ASIDE AND COUNTED, never hidden - each run prints how many
were set aside and the reason recorded here.
A rule matches a finding when every field it SPECIFIES matches. Omitting a
field lets it match anything, so an empty rule matches everything - prefer
more fields, not fewer. Available fields: kind, activityType, dev, prod.
kind is one of MISSING IN PROD, EXTRA IN PROD, TYPE DIFFERS, STATE DIFFERS,
DEFINITION DIFFERS.
expectDifferent on a pair marks that ONE OBJECT as known to differ in CONTENT,
not just in name. Deliberately narrower than an expectedDifferences rule, which
applies everywhere and could hide a real regression in a different object.
label on a rule is a short phrase shown on the summary line, so the row says
what was allowed rather than only how many.
ALWAYS fill in reason. It is printed on every run. A suppression with no reason
is one nobody remembers agreeing to.
REVIEW THIS FILE WHEN THE PLATFORM CHANGES. The semantic model entry below is
true only while development holds fewer models than production.

pairs.reason: The semantic model refresh pipeline carries its environment in its name, which is useful when looking at a workspace. Confirmed 2026-09-02 to map the pair here rather than rename either object. It is also expected to DIFFER IN CONTENT: the development workspace holds only one semantic model at present, so its pipeline refreshes one where production refreshes eight. Confirmed 2026-09-02.

expectedDifferences.reason: Email activities are deliberately disabled in development, so development runs do not notify the production distribution list. Confirmed 2026-09-02.
expectedDifferences.label: dev email activities are switched off
